q: Which defense actually stops an exfiltration attack rather than only making it less likely?
options: A system prompt telling the model to ignore instructions in documents
An egress allowlist that blocks unapproved destinations
Asking the model to be careful
explain: Removing the capability, here the way out, stops the attack regardless of what the model is persuaded to do.

q: What are the three legs of the lethal trifecta?
options: Private data access, exposure to untrusted content and a way to send data out
explain: Remove any one and that class of data theft fails.

q: A summarization agent reads web pages. Which change best reduces its blast radius?
options: Removing its email and HTTP-send tools, since summarizing does not need them
explain: Least privilege: a hijacked summarizer without send tools has nothing dangerous to do.
